subject: bench
name: 长椅
label: 公园铁艺长椅
learning: 先观察主体各部分怎样连接，再挑几处有特点的细节。
prompt:
Use case: original standalone picture-book illustration for Nilo children's drawing references. Make ONE square monochrome raster artwork, beautifully hand-drawn with confident dark charcoal-black contours, graceful proportions and clean open white spaces. White or genuinely transparent background, preserve ample clear margin all around, complete subject fully visible. No color fills, gray washes, shading, dense hatching, fine texture, logos, letters, numbers, border, collage, grid, watermark or instructional steps. Do not imitate a named artist. MEDIUM reference: an elegant observational picture-book drawing with a clear coherent silhouette, 6–10 separated distinguishing structural details and natural joined parts. Richer form than an icon, without intricate texture or dense repeated marks. A park bench at three-quarter view, three broad back slats, curved armrests and visible joined legs, no background.
Strict correction: retain a three-quarter park bench but use two broad backrest slats and two broad seat slats with simple curved arms and joined legs. Clean single black contour drawing on solid opaque white paper, white unshaded interiors. No gradients, no gray fills, no screws or tiny hardware. 12 percent margin.
